_comment: Human-verified rulings for November ballot questions the Commission's certified primary results and ballot-access report cannot settle on their own. 'candidates': a ballot-access challenge the report still shows as Challenged, decided at a Commission meeting. 'contests': a primary the certified totals leave unresolved (for example a write-in who may have qualified under s. 8.16(2)); nominee is a name in that contest, or null for no nominee. Every entry needs an official basis URL. An entry the data does not need fails the import.

candidates.note: EL 26-34 Trevor Ford v. Nathan Tataje: 211 valid signatures; the Commission added him to the approved list (motion carried 6-0).
EL 26-36 Stephen Mueller v. Rustin Provance: 1,369 valid signatures; the Commission added him to the approved list (motion carried 6-0).
EL 26-37 Brian Norby v. Elizabeth Anne Fitzgibbon: 1,278 valid signatures; the Commission added her to the approved list (motion carried 6-0).
